usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the solution in `main.rs`. It compiles, and I ran only Example 2 (`5`, `a b a`, `B c`). That printed `a 2`, `b 2`, `c 1`, as expected. I did not run Example 1 or any edge cases, such as fewer words than K or an input with no words.

It reads all of stdin and takes K from the first line. In the rest of the input, it splits words on any byte that isn't an ASCII letter or digit and lower-case
